post.description: Accepts only customerId and productId/quantity lines. Consolidates duplicate products (at most 10,000 per product), locks Customer then Products deterministically and calculates prices on the server. Subtotal >= EUR 100.00 receives a 10% HALF_UP discount. At most three independent attempts follow confirmed rollback; uncertain commits are never replayed.

quantity.description: Positive JSON integer token (not 1.0, exponents, strings or booleans). Consolidated quantity per product must not exceed 10,000.

name.description: After stripping surrounding Unicode whitespace: 1–200 Unicode code points. Malformed surrogate sequences are rejected.

price.description: EUR gross price: 0–999999.99, ordinary JSON decimal spelling, at most two source decimal places. Exponents, strings and coercion are rejected.
